_meta.note: Captured off the wire by a scratch client: `opencode acp` 1.19.1, the Real Adapter Contract lane's pin (test/real_adapters/package.json, npm ci), against a loopback OpenAI-compatible model stub reached through opencode's @ai-sdk/openai-compatible provider, with a throwaway HOME; the stub asks for the tool the prompt names with one tool call and answers the tool result with first-done, plus pineapple when a user message asks for it, so no real model or credential was involved. Crew's routing seed (permission ask) on OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT. The first session/prompt (id 3) gets a bash `sleep 6 && echo first-done`, answered allow_once. Once the tool runs, a second session/prompt (id 4) carries the steer, asking for the word pineapple. opencode sent ONE more model request after the bash result, and it carried both the tool result and the steer as the latest user message; the turn's final answer is `first-done pineapple`, and ids 3 and 4 were answered end_turn together, under a millisecond apart, with no output of the steer's own before them. Reduced through capture_acp_compaction.reduce_frames: 2 configOptions select(s) cut to the one option naming its currentValue: the full list is the provider and model catalog the recording host could reach; 1 available_commands_update/session_info_update frame(s) dropped: they carry the recording host's own command inventory and run id; the scratch working directory is replaced with <cwd>; the session id is replaced with the synthetic opencode-session-1; message id(s) replaced with synthetic msg-N values.
